text: John William Henry II (born September 13, 1949) is an American businessman. He is the owner of the Boston Red Sox and Roush Fenway Racing. He is also the owner of the association football team Liverpool F.C. of the Premier League. He is one of the 50 richest people in Boston.
title: John W. Henry

text: Absolut Vodka is a brand of Vodka that was first made in 1879 and originally made in Sweden. It is owned by the French company Pernod Ricard Holding Company. It openly embraces the gay community and is official sponsor of the GLAAD Media Awards. It is the third largest alcoholic spirts company in the world.
title: Absolut Vodka

text: Francisco Alejandro Pérez Martínez (11 May 1932 – 28 August 2007), better known as Francisco Umbral, was a Spanish journalist, novelist, biographer and essayist. In 2000, Umbral won the Miguel de Cervantes Prize.
title: Francisco Umbral

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Carlos Roberto Flores Facussé (born 10 March 1950) is a Honduran politician and businessman. He was the 33rd President of Honduras from 27 January 1998 to 27 January 2002. He is a member of the Liberal Party. Flores was the President of the National Congress from 25 January 1994 to 25 January 1998.
title: Carlos Roberto Flores

text: Cesár Sampson (born 18 August 1983) is an Austrian singer, songwriter and model. He represented Austria in the Eurovision Song Contest 2018 with the song "Nobody but You", winning the jury vote, coming in 13th place in the televote and finishing in third place overall.
title: Cesár Sampson
